risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and specific, with improving earnings, capital ratios, nonperforming loans, and other real estate owned balances. Credit and market risks remain, including real-estate concentration, low interest rates, unrealized trust-preferred security losses, and additional loans becoming past due and non-accrual. Repeated boilerplate forward-looking language and duplicated credit-quality discussion modestly reduce clarity.
